name: Green Receipt – Messaging App + API (Co-Existence) Plug-in
author: aartirathee

sections.description:
Unlock powerful WhatsApp API features without leaving your WhatsApp Business App.
📲 Overview
Green Receipt lets you seamlessly use WhatsApp Business API on your existing number — while continuing to use your WhatsApp Business App. No more choosing between app or API — enjoy both, side by side.
⚙️ Key Features
• API + App Co-existence: Use your WhatsApp Business App and APIs on the same number — no migration or downtime.
• Multi-platform Access: Maintain full access to chat history, contacts, and storefront tools.
• Advanced API Capabilities: Enable interactive messages, automated chat flows, bookings, CRM integration, abandoned cart and order notifications.
• Commerce-Ready: Send cart updates, payment alerts, and delivery confirmations via WhatsApp — all Shopify-triggered.
🚀 Why Green Receipt?
Whether you’re scaling support or driving sales, Green Receipt powers communication across the customer journey — without breaking your WhatsApp flow.
🛠️ Built for Shopify merchants looking to scale chat, automate messages, and drive conversions through WhatsApp.

Features:
* Notify order, delivery & abandoned cart status directly via existing WhatsApp Business App .
* Create WhatsApp Commerce Channel with Unique Store Front & end-to-end Commerce within your WhatsApp Business App
* Send Digital Invoices on WhatsApp with built in Shop Again & Pay action buttons!
* Sends store info to external API on order creation.

Installation

  1. Search for “green-receipt-buy” on the “Add Plugin” page and activate it.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
    3.Select the events you link to drop WhatsApp notifications.
  3. Upon activation, the plugin sends store details to the Green Receipt API and fetches the merchant token.
  4. The plugin automatically sends WhatsApp notifications for new orders ,order status updates and Abandoned Cart .
  5. Product changes will sync with the catalog automatically.

Arbitrary section

For support or feature requests, please contact the author at https://buynxt.in/.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later license.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to send WhatsApp notifications for order status updates and abandoned cart recovery.

  • What is sent: Customer phone number, order ID, order status, and product information
  • When: Data is sent only when a new order is created, its status changes, or when an abandoned cart is detected
  • Where: The data is securely transmitted to https://api.greenreceipt.in/webhook/woocommerce

Service Terms: https://buynxt.in/terms-%26-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://buynxt.in/privacy-policy
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be active.

How are WhatsApp messages sent?

Currently, WhatsApp messages are logged to a local file (whatsapp_log.txt) for debugging. Integration with a real WhatsApp API can be added in the send_whatsapp_message() function.

How can I customize the messages?

You can customize the message templates inside the functions wc_send_whatsapp_order_notification() and wc_whatsapp_on_status_change().

Does this plugin handle abandoned cart tracking?

Yes, it includes abandoned cart tracking and cron job support via included classes.
